basin_name.value: Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin (WCSB) / Alberta Basin

basin_evidence.value: Located in central Alberta within the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin foreland basin, targeting Leduc Formation carbonate reefs of the Rimbey-Meadowbrook reef trend (Bashaw Reef Complex).

project_type.value: Pressure-depleted saline aquifer in dolomitized carbonate reef

target_formation.value: Leduc Formation (Upper Devonian, Woodbend Group), Lacombe Field

status.value: AER Approval No. 13463 issued 30 July 2025; pre-injection

permeability_md.value: <10 to >100 mD (well range); regional avg ~26 mD

pressure_mpa.value: 15.3 MPa (2,219 psia initial); max allowable 20 MPa @ 2,070 m TVD

storage_capacity.value: Phase 1: 28 Mt (1.6 Mt/yr × 17.5 yr); full-scale: up to 20 Mt/yr, several hundred Mt total

area_km2.value: Plume: ~50 km² nominal (4 km radius), ~99 km² max (5.6 km radius); lease: ~10,082 km² (2,491,617 acres)

site_name.value: Boundary Dam Integrated CCS (BD3) — Weyburn-Midale Beds & Aquistore

basin_evidence.value: The Williston Basin is a structural basin overlying the cratonic platform of North America, with Paleozoic carbonate and clastic reservoirs. The Weyburn-Midale Beds are Mississippian carbonates at ~1,450 m; Aquistore targets Cambro-Ordovician Deadwood Fm / Black Island Member at ~3.1–3.4 km depth.

project_type.value: CO₂-EOR (Weyburn-Midale Beds) + Saline aquifer storage (Aquistore — Deadwood Fm / Black Island Member)

target_formation.value: Weyburn-Midale Beds (Mississippian Charles Fm) — Marly dolostone and Vuggy limestone; Aquistore: Deadwood Fm / Black Island Member (Cambro-Ordovician)

status.value: Operational — Weyburn CO₂-EOR since Oct 2000; Aquistore injection since Apr 2015; BD3 capture since Oct 2014

operator.value: SaskPower (capture); PTRC / SaskPower (Aquistore); Whitecap Resources (Weyburn EOR)

depth_m.value: Weyburn: ~1,450 m (range 1,400–1,562 m); Aquistore: ~3,130–3,350 m (top to base reservoir)

porosity_pct.value: Weyburn Marly: 25% log (range 16–38%), 17% core/stressed; Vuggy: 10–12%. Aquistore Deadwood/Black Island: ~7% site-specific (6–7.1% multiple sources); 10–15% in perforated zones

permeability_md.value: Weyburn Marly: 6–10 mD matrix (1–100 mD range), enhanced by fractures; Vuggy: 6–50 mD matrix (0.1–500 mD range). Aquistore: ~5 mD core; 20–150 mD field-scale effective

net_pay_m.value: Weyburn Marly net pay: 4 m; Vuggy net pay: 8 m; total Midale Beds ~15–25 m gross. Aquistore: gross reservoir ~290 m (Deadwood ~250 m + Black Island ~40 m); net perforated 200 m

pressure_mpa.value: Weyburn: initial ~14 MPa, current ~15 MPa (range 12.5–18 MPa); fracture ~34 MPa. Aquistore: initial 34.2–35 MPa; fracture ~48 MPa; BHP <42 MPa

storage_capacity.value: Weyburn: ~30 Mt cumulative CO₂ stored (EOR). Aquistore: >585,000 t stored (through ~2024). BD3 capture: 7,327,868 t total (Oct 2014–Dec 2025)

area_km2.value: Weyburn pool: ~180–220 km². Aquistore: ~30–34 km² (seismic/model extent); regional Cambro-Ordovician aquifer >100,000 km²
